name: Abusive Marriages
overview: Scripture underscores the sanctity of marriage and warns against betrayal and violence within it. The Lord expresses His hatred for putting away a spouse unjustly, especially when it covers violence, urging believers to guard their spirits against treachery. Gentle and gracious speech is encouraged to turn away wrath, highlighting the importance of peace in marital relationships. Furthermore, Jesus teaches the seriousness of sin and the permanence of marriage, challenging attempts to dissolve it lightly.
